## 怎么验证的 / How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] `uv run pytest`（改了提取器或工具时 / if the extractor or tools changed）
- [ ] 界面改动在生产预览里看过桌面和手机宽度、深浅主题，并附了截图 / UI changes checked in a production preview on desktop and mobile, light and dark, with screenshots
- [ ] 页面文字经过 `tr()` / `t()` 并补了翻译 / Page text goes through `tr()` / `t()` with translations
